stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup Series 3 — 8 Days Out, Kowalik Leads Into Final Stretch
stories.angle: Series 3 opens August 24 at Parkway Bank Sports Complex, Rosemont IL. First 4-team series of the 2026 All-Star Cup. Kowalik leads the individual leaderboard heading in as captain again. Can she run the table? Final two series (3 + 4) determine the champion, with Aug 30 as the finale. Ricketts, Coffey, Netz also captaining.

stories.title: North Carolina Wins 2026 Little League Softball World Series
stories.angle: Johnston County LL (Clayton, NC) def. Kentucky 2-0. Pitcher Anna-Lynn Clark threw back-to-back shutouts to close the tournament — 109 pitches/11 K on Friday, 93 pitches/3 H/6 K in the title game Saturday. Belle Cox drove in the only run of the championship with a single in the 2nd inning — same spot she opened scoring the game before.

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Friday: 109 pitches. 11 strikeouts. Shutout. Saturday: 93 pitches. 6 strikeouts. Shutout. Anna-Lynn Clark went back-to-back to win the 2026 Little League Softball World Series for North Carolina. That's what unhittable looks like. #LLSWS #ILoveSoftball

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Johnston County, North Carolina wins the 2026 Little League Softball World Series! NC defeated Kentucky 2-0. Belle Cox drove in the only run with a clutch single in the 2nd inning. Pitch. Catch. Win. Anna-Lynn Clark made it look easy. #LLSWS #NCSoftball #ILoveSoftball

stories.title: September 1 — 16 Days to D1 First-Contact Window (Class of 2028)
stories.angle: 16 days. D1 coaches can make live voice contact with Class of 2028 recruits starting September 1. Right now: coaches limited to printed materials and certain electronic comms only — no live calls. Phones ring on September 1 morning. For families, this is the most pivotal moment in the recruiting cycle.

stories.title: Texas Longhorns 2027 — Staff Complete, Now Prep Begins for Three-Peat Chase
stories.angle: With Rick Fremin (AHC, 10-yr HC at SLU) and Amber Freeman (hitting coach from Arizona) now in place, Mike White has his full staff assembled. Ehren Earleywine and Kristen Zaleski departed. The challenge: replacing two impactful assistants while maintaining the standard that produced back-to-back WCWS titles. Kavan enters senior year as the first 2x WCWS MOP in history.
